items.title: Johnny St. Cyr Interview, 1958-08-27
items.q: Uptown, Lorenzo Starrs and I, with the best guitar players.

ctx.x: Yeah, you were writing this to him next. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah, you must have known them all, I guess. I never said it. Yes.

And he was the good ones, then the bad ones. Yeah. Yeah. Now, up- Uptown, Lorenzo Starrs and I, with the best guitar players. And, uh, downtown, Joe Brooks, you know, old days. Joe Brooks and Willie San Diego.
Willie San Diego was better than any of them.
